# AANGAN

> AANGAN is an Indian brand of handcrafted Diwali and festive home décor: diyas and diya holders, tealight holders, torans, Shubh Labh hangings, latkans and door hangings, made by hand with pearls, mirror work, golden embellishments, stonework and embroidery. Tagline: Where Tradition Glows.

- Website: https://aangan.co.in/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aangan.co.in
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/916354848946
- How to order: add pieces to the bag on the website (or tap Buy now) and enter delivery details; WhatsApp opens with the order. AANGAN confirms availability, shipping and the total, then shares a payment link. Nothing is charged before confirmation.
- Custom creations: requested through the website's "Request a custom creation" form, which opens WhatsApp with the brief.
- Prices are in Indian rupees (INR). Current offer: flat 20% off for Diwali.
